draft.text: You came in because you have back pain and tingling in your right foot.
This started after you raked leaves yesterday.
You don't have numbness or weakness in your legs.
You also don't have changes in bowel or bladder function.
Your symptoms may be from a strain or sprain in your back.
This could be from the physical activity of raking leaves.
You will need to rest and avoid heavy lifting or bending for a few days.
We will see you again to check your symptoms and decide if more treatment is needed.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have back pain and tingling in your right foot.
This started after you raked leaves yesterday.
Your back pain feels like a tightening and is constant.
It does not spread to other areas.
